title: American Greed
description:
S15 E10 — The Accused Crypto Couple
Heather Morgan transforms herself into a business owner, journalist and fledgling rap artist known as Razzlekhan; she and her husband stand accused of laundering $4.5 billion worth of stolen bitcoin, breaking a government record.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E1 — Bound for Murder
Fontainebleau Miami Beach hotel heir Ben Novack Jr. is bludgeoned to death three months after his mother, Bernice, is found dead under suspicious circumstances; Novack's wife, Narcy, a former stripper, becomes the key to unlocking this sordid case.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E2 — The Dungeon Master
Wealthy suburbanite Jane Bashara is found strangled to death in a seedy part of Detroit known for drugs, crime and murder; a handyman is charged, but that's only the beginning of the story which is ultimately about sex, lies and betrayal.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E3 — A Glittering Murder
Living a golden life, entrepreneurs James and Pamela Fayed turn a fledgling coin company into a gold trading empire; after Pamela is brutally stabbed to death, her murder case reveals a federal fraud investigation and a marriage filled with lies.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E9 — Kevin Trudeau's Secrets; Remington Steal
When the FTC fines Infomercial kingpin Kevin Trudeau $37.6 million for all of his get-rich-quick schemes, he claims he's flat broke; Remington Financial Group's "advance fee" scam has cost small business owners their dreams and millions of dollars.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E2 — The Playboy of Indiana
A man with a multimillion-dollar yacht, 80 sports cars and a Playboy magazine model girlfriend runs a $200 million fraud.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E7 — Fine Art: A Portrait of Fraud
Viewers tune in to watch a live auction show that turns out to be nothing more than con artists selling fake art.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E8 — Loan Scam: Money for Nothing; Hawaiian Punched: Fraud in Paradise
A sting operation brings down a Denver businessman; a charismatic con man uses the promise of huge returns to put $30 million in his own pocket.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E13 — The Wizard of Sarasota
Arthur Nadel conjures up a huge hedge fund. Then he disappears and leaves clients without their life savings. Get the inside story on a multi-million-dollar Ponzi scheme.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E7 — The Bling Ring; The Fraudster, the Ex-Stripper and the Missing Millions
A group of wannabe-celebs make off with millions from Hollywood's rich and famous.
